services.name: Fort Pilates
services.desc: Welcome! We’re so glad you’re here. If you’re new to Pilates, this page will help you understand how to get started safely and confidently. At our studio, we prioritize proper technique and individualized attention-especially for new clients. Pilates equipment like the Reformer and Tower are unique and require a short orientation period to ensure safety and effectiveness. Pilates is more than a workout-it’s a movement system that builds strength from the inside out.Here’s what you can expect to gain from a consistent practice: Deep abdominal and spinal support that improves posture, balance, and overall body

blurb: Fort Pilates is where movement and recovery come together. Strengthen your body through energizing Reformer Tower classes or personalized sessions, then restore with infrared sauna, salt and red-light therapy, and cold plunge.
